basic_info.description: This is the first resale of #106. Newly refreshed interiors including paint, lighting and new appliances including washer/dryer. The kitchen and both bathrooms feature Studio Becker cabinetry and granite counters. This wonderful layout offers a desirable split floor plan with two large bedrooms and two bathrooms. The home is one of only a handful that come with a private expansive patio, with sliding door access from all rooms.  All homes at The Lansing feature air conditioning and parking for one car.  Additionally, the sellers also own two deeded storage units which will convey with the sale. Remarkably quiet and located on the ground floor allowing you to enter at street level with no need to utilize a shared elevator. The Lansing is an 82-unit boutique building with fitness center, sun terrace, furnished resident lounge, communal BBQ and outside dining areas and arguably the best roof terrace in all of South Beach.  Professionally managed.
